title: Unaware of My Demise
short: Dark-fantasy turn-based story game. Gather sworn companions, hold the Sanctuary.
full:
Unaware of My Demise is a dark-fantasy, turn-based story game. The bells of a ruined sanctuary have stopped, an Eclipse is coming, and a small company of sworn companions is all that stands between the living and the dark.

SWORN COMPANIONS
Gather 25 companions at the Altar of Bells. Each has a full chibi battle form, a story of their own, three skills and an ultimate, and a bond that grows as you play.

TURN-BASED BATTLES YOU PLAY BY HAND
Five heroes in two rows face the dead of the Whispering Ash Forest, the ruined Cathedral of Saint Luthos and beyond. Choose your skills and targets, build Focus for ultimates, and read the enemy's telegraphed moves. Auto mode is only an option.

A STORY WORTH READING
Seven chapters of Part I told as a visual novel with Japanese voiced narration and lead characters, branching scenes, a codex and companion stories you unlock as bonds deepen.

MORE TO DO
Daily errands and deeds, rotating events with their own shops, Arena, Endless Blood Moon, weekly hunts, and relic forging.

FAIR BY DESIGN
Summon rates and pity counters are shown in the game. You can export or delete your account data from inside the game.

Sign in with Google to save your progress to the cloud, or play as a guest on your device.
